newsitem.title: USA: Air Freight Association changes name.
newsitem.headline: Air Freight Association changes name.

text.p: The Air Freight Association will change its name to the Cargo Airline Association, its top executive said Monday.
"We will be changing it effective March 1," Steve Alterman, president of the association, told Reuters.
The new name "better reflects who we are and what we do," Doug Kuelpman, vice president of United Parcel Service, said in a statement being prepared to announce the new name.
The association has 20 U.S.-based all-cargo airlines as members. They include freight carriers and package carriers, Alterman said.
